metadata.description: Optional parent Service Group resource ID. Leave empty for a root-level Service Group (defaults to the tenant-root Service Group).
Azure Health Model (Microsoft.CloudHealth/healthmodels) created against this Service Group. step2's Drill references this via healthModelMonitoringProperties.healthModelId.

specification.resourceGraphQuery: [format('relationshipresources | where type =~ ''microsoft.relationships/servicegroupmember'' | where tostring(properties.TargetId) =~ ''{0}'' | project id=tostring(properties.SourceId) | union (resourcecontainers | where id =~ ''{0}'' | project id)', variables('serviceGroupResourceId'))]
